subject: Staged conversion allowance & burst-month plan for Dedicated migration
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@catalyst.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sabrina O'Neill <sabrina@catalyst.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:18:00Z
Subject: Initial sizing + ask: conversion allowance and bridge months

Irene — thanks for the demo earlier. Catalyst Labs is trying to firm up an economic model for moving a portion of our hosted usage to a Dedicated GPU pool. Two immediate asks:

1) Do you have a standard "conversion allowance" you apply when converting hosted spend into a committed Dedicated baseline? We're looking to convert ~350k hosted monthly token spend into a 3-6 month staged commit.
2) We expect a heavy launch month where we need burst capacity for ~6 weeks. Can you outline options for short-term burst buffers (additional GPUs billed differently) and whether those months affect the committed baseline true-up?

Attached is a rough spreadsheet with our current usage profile and a first-pass pool sizing request.

Thanks — if you can reply with a sketch of economics (credits, any discrete discount tiers for 12/24/36 mo commits, and how bridge months are applied) that would help our procurement loop.

—Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of Platform, Catalyst Labs
alex@catalyst.ai

Attachments: catalyst_proposed_commit.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T13:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial sizing + ask: conversion allowance and bridge months

Alex — really appreciate the clear context and the spreadsheet. Quick answers up front:

- Conversion allowance: we typically provide a time-phased conversion allowance when migrating usage from Hosted to Dedicated to offset double-billing during onboarding. For a staged commit we can offer a conversion allowance equal to 40% of the average hosted spend for the first 3 months, stepping down to 20% for months 4–6. This is modeled as a credit applied to invoices rather than a one-time rebate.

- Burst-months/buffer: we support a "burst buffer" (extra pre-negotiated GPUs available for short windows) billed at a higher per-GPU rate but not counted against the committed baseline if used in clearly defined launch windows. We usually cap burst buffers to 30–50% of baseline for up to 8 weeks; longer bursts convert to temporary reserved capacity with prorated crediting.

I attached a concise proposal outlining a 6-month staged migration: 3-month heavy onboarding with 40% conversion allowance, 3-month taper at 20%, plus two burst months (6 GPUs) that are billed separately and excluded from committed true-up. Pricing buckets included: 12/24/36-month commit discounts and the effect on unit token cost.

I'll loop in Marissa for final pricing approval and Karthik to confirm any SLA/throughput guarantees tied to committed tiers.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_conversion_allowance_v2.pdf (proposal, 22KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-06T10:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Initial sizing + ask: conversion allowance and burst months

Irene/Team — read through the proposed credit curve. A few internal notes before we return a commercial term sheet to Alex:

- Approve the 40%/20% staged credit as a starting point for < $500k monthly baseline; for > $500k we should move to 50%/25% to help accelerate commitments.
- Burst buffer: approve up to two nominal burst months at +45% per-GPU premium, excluded from baseline true-up. Anything beyond two months needs exec sign-off.
- SLA/throughput: commit tiers (small/medium/large pools) should include token-per-second throughput guarantees tied to GPU counts. We can offer an opt-in 99.9% latency SLO for 24/36 month commits at a 2.5% service credit.

One more ask: if customer wants to convert earlier (month 2) we can allow early conversion with a 6-week notice and pro-rated carry-forward of remaining conversion credits.

I'll let Mateo price the revised 12/24/36 tables and produce a compact term sheet.

-M
Marissa Cole
Head of Enterprise Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@catalyst.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T15:30:00Z
Subject: Term sheet: staged conversion allowance + burst months (Catalyst Labs)

Alex — attaching the price tables below as a copy in the body and as a reference doc in HubSpot. Key points:

- Baseline sizing recommendation: 8x A100-equivalent GPUs (targeted for steady-state given your 350k token/month), with an additional 6 GPUs reserved as a burst buffer for the two launch months.
- Conversion allowance: 40% credit on average hosted spend applied months 1–3, 20% on months 4–6 as invoice credits. If baseline commit >= 24 months, we increase to 50%/25% respectively.
- Commit discounts (effective per-token): 12 mo = -12%, 24 mo = -22%, 36 mo = -30% (applies after conversion credits).
- Burst billing: Burst GPUs billed at a 45% premium per GPU-hour; burst usage excluded from weekly baseline utilization calculations and does not reduce conversion credits.
- True-up policy: Monthly true-up against committed GPU hours; unused committed units roll forward for a single 30-day window only.
- SLA: 99.9% latency SLO add-on available for 24/36 mo commits with 2.5% credit for missed windows.

If Catalyst wants a 3rd burst month, we can offer it at a 60% premium but it will consume 50% of the remaining conversion credits (exec sign-off required).

Full term sheet doc: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7890123 (see attachments tab).

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Pricing & Solutions, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments: (see HubSpot record)

From: Alex Morgan <alex@catalyst.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sabrina O'Neill <sabrina@catalyst.ai>, CloudOps Consulting <engage@cloudops.co>
Date: 2026-08-12T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Term sheet: staged conversion allowance + burst months (Catalyst Labs)

Irene/Team — this looks good and aligns with our procurement constraints. Two quick clarifications before we go to legal:

1) Can the conversion credits be presented as a single line item credit on the first invoice instead of multiple monthly credits? Procurement prefers upfront line items for capex planning. We understand the cash-flow impact and are open to adjusting the discount ladder in return.
2) Our launch calendar slipped; we now need three burst months (May-July equivalent). Given your note on 3rd month at premium and conversion credit consumption, could you provide two options: (A) keep the 3rd month at 60% premium and deduct 50% of remaining conversion credits, or (B) keep premium at 45% but reduce conversion allowance by a flat 10% across months 1–6. We need the numbers to present to finance.

If you can send a short, consumable comparison table (A vs B) and a one-line recommended commercial position, we can route to legal and procurement tomorrow.

—Alex
Alex Morgan
Head of Platform, Catalyst Labs
alex@catalyst.ai

Note: Catalysts would like the accounting-friendly single-line credit if possible.
